_comment: Row 328. The battery restores the vanishing-open refusal, launders a present EACCES into VANISHED, corrupts the exact vanished denominator, drops real findings, and disables the derived Chromium profile marker. Each mutant has a named behavioral catcher in the real scanner subprocess. The companion transform control applies M1 byte-for-byte to a stable scan and must ESCAPE.
